people.name: Enosh
people.line: Son of Seth, during whose time people called on the Lord's name.

people.name: Seth
people.line: Third son of Adam and Eve, ancestor of righteous line

translations.web: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.
